message.content:
Below is a quick reference on how you would retrieve **only the object‑IDs** of all CNAME records for `sample.com` through the VirusTotal (VT) v2/v3 REST API.  
(Replace `<YOUR_API_KEY>` with your real key – here it’s shown as *secret123*.)

---

### 1️⃣ Build the HTTP GET Request  

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Base URL | https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/ |
| Endpoint | `{DOMAIN_NAME}` + `/dns_records` |
| Query String | `?query=record_type:CNAME` |

> Example full URL:
>
> ```
> https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?query=record_type:CNAME
> ```

Add the header:

```
x-apikey: secret123
Accept: application/json
```

---

### 2️⃣ Execute & Parse Only the “id” Fields  

```bash
curl -s \
     --request GET \
     --url "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?query=record_type:CNAME" \
     --header "x-apikey: secret123" \
     --header "accept: application/vnd.api+json" \
   | jq '.data[].attributes.id'
```

#### What this does

1. Calls the VT API for DNS records filtered to type **CNAME**.  
2. Uses `jq` to pull out the `"id"` attribute from each record (`data[]`).  
3. Prints one ID per line—no other fields are exposed.

If you prefer pure Python without external tooling:

```python
import requests

API_URL = ("https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/"
           "domains/sample.com/dns_records")
HEADERS = {
    "x-apikey": "secret123",
    "accept": "application/vnd.api+json"
}
PARAMS = {"query": "record_type:CNAME"}

resp = requests.get(API_URL, headers=HEADERS, params=PARAMS)
records = resp.json()["data"]
ids_only = [rec["attributes"]["id"] for rec in records]
print(ids_only)
```

Both snippets will give you something like:

```
[
  "abcd1234efgh5678ijkl9012mnop3456qrst7890uvwx2345yzab6789cdef0123",
  ...
]
```

Only the UUID strings (object IDs) appear—everything else is omitted.
